build_notes: wars/aftermath.py. If passed: apply the death % to the attacked/target province's population (pick the most populous province if no province is targeted).
detail: Right now winning attacks kill 0.1-0.3% (ground) or 0.2-0.6% (bombers) of the whole nation.
title: Should civilian deaths from winning an attack hit only the province that was attacked, instead of a % of the whole nation?
